triggered_by: User's H1 comparison feedback: '1   。2   把文字都改的不对了。中国文字不能乱加笔画。'
authority: User design requirement and user visual rejection; not a lexicographic ruling on the exact normative stroke count.
rule: Chinese glyph identity must be correct before design aesthetics are evaluated. Decorative marks cannot be added as if they were original writing strokes; historical-style reauthoring may transform or merge existing semantic strokes only when the original components remain legible, with documented mappings.
stage_order: S0: freeze exact simplified/traditional target and genuine reference glyph from a reliable authorized font/dictionary
S1: require component and semantic stroke map; identify each reauthored contour's originating legitimate stroke(s)
S2: verify no new unrelated marks, altered radical, missing needed component, illegible counterspace or confused writing
S3: test native and 96/64px reading first; user-reported written-form error immediately invalidates candidate
S4: compare aesthetics only among both semantically valid candidate and baseline
S5: after human approval, editable Figma nodes and cross-word holdout; technical path count is NEVER proof of Chinese stroke correctness
hard_vetoes: Any added independent stroke not traceable to a real stroke in the correct target character
Any merged/split stroke that destroys the semantic Hanzi component structure or user recognizability
Unsupported stroke omission, wrong component placement or a visually different character
Using SVG VECTOR path count, changed pixel count or a prettier line as a substitute for Hanzi writing validity
Comparing aesthetics after the user rejects a candidate for wrong writing; such comparisons are invalid

test_case.winner_by_choice: 方案甲 (R15 C1 original middle integration) - reference retained but not certified
test_case.user_quote: 1   。2   把文字都改的不对了。中国文字不能乱加笔画。
test_case.meaning: The user rejected B as wrong-looking Chinese writing; only a pinned 12-stroke semantic mapping can check whether claimed new strokes exist. B's separated marks occupy pre-existing 7/8/9 roles; no extra official stroke was demonstrated.

bounds: Correctness is a hard gate, but SVG path count is unrelated to official stroke count. Map semantic stroke role and then require human approval; neither scheme counts as textbook pen strokes from its vector path length.
future: Do not repeat the same 甲/乙 vote. Only continue after correctness of all candidate glyphs is independently vetted; if not possible, retain original and stop.

official_reference_update.canonical: 喜 U+559C has 12 strokes, names 横竖横竖横折横点撇横竖横折横; source CNS11643 and MOE.
official_reference_update.important_technical_correction: 甲 art vector outlines=14 and 乙 outlines=15; neither number equals normative 12 brush strokes. 乙 three separated middle contours correspond to normative dot, left-falling stroke and horizontal, so no dictionary extra stroke was established.
official_reference_update.previous_user_judgment_kept: 乙 rejected by user's glyph/writing perception; that rejection is valid for user's approval but not proof of an extra normative stroke.
official_reference_update.future_check_sequence: SOURCE_GLYPH_PIN -> SEMANTIC_STROKE_MAP -> ADDED_OR_MISSING_PATH_VETO -> REAL_READER_GLYPH_ACCEPTANCE -> AESTHETICS -> FIGMA
